reviews.title: Great compact AIO
reviews.comment: Its easy to install to a point lol had a little issue getting it screwed into the cpu base but I got it eventually lol. First time installing my own AIO its really simple. Just like I said it was me not the product causing the issue. Vibrant colors, slick black fans and radiator. Not much noise. Definitely worth the 40 some freedom bucks. I was going to go with a 360 but couldn't get it to fit in my h6 flow case bc my motherboard is a bit chunky and sits high and I just could not get it to fit a 360 up top. So I just went smaller with the 240. Im definitely a noob builder.
reviews.author: Jared Powers

reviews.title: It's the best you can get for the price!
reviews.comment:
I had several doubts when buying because it looked very good for the price, and usually when a product offers a lot for a low cost, it tends to be a disappointment. This is not the case here.
ADVANTAGES:
- To begin with, the price is half or less than what a similar product from one of the top brands costs.
- Aesthetically, it's just as good as other brands. It comes with LED fans and an LED on the processor cooler, giving the PC a more stylish look.
- It keeps the CPU cool, has good heat dissipation. I live in a very hot city, and at idle, my processor doesn't go above 40°C; under full load, it reaches up to 60°C. I currently have a Ryzen 5700X.
CONS:
Installing the CPU cooler can be a bit frustrating. It only has two screws that attach to the CPU, but you have to give it a tiny turn to get it to fit on one side, and then do the same on the other. If you overtighten, it will pop off the other side. It's quite annoying, and it's the only downside I've found so far compared to installing other AIO coolers. However, it just takes a little patience.
P.S. I modified the fan coolers to perfectly match the case, but the stock ones are very good and look nice; they don't make much noise.
In conclusion, I highly recommend this product. For the price, it offers excellent performance and LEDs that will make your PC look even better.
reviews.author: Anthony B.

reviews.title: Thermalright showing high performance at a low cost!
reviews.comment: Was confused a bit by the mounting kit they sent for am5, but I reached out to their cs their response was blazing quick and they had a video showing how it works. The cooler itself works very well. The infinity mirror effect is neat. Killer value for what you get performance and looks wise.
